verses.sanskrit:
वासुदेव उवाच।
              द्विविधो जायते व्याधिः शारीरो मानसस्तथा। परस्परं तयोर्जन्म निर्द्वन्द्वं नोपपद्यते॥१॥
verses.english: There are two kinds of diseases, physical and mental. They are produced by the mutua? action of the body and mind on cach other, and they never originate without the interaction of the two.

verses.sanskrit: शरीरे जायते व्याधिः शारीरः स निगद्यते। मानसे जायते व्याधिर्मानसस्तु निगद्यते॥२॥
verses.english: The disease that is produced in the body, is called physical, and that which is produced in the mind, is called mental.
verses.bhavadeepa: वज्रशब्दोक्तं विवेकं दर्शयति स्थूलसूक्ष्मदेहयोर्वैधर्म्यप्रदर्शनेन द्विविध इत्यादिना। परस्परमिति सत्त्वादिगुणजं सूक्ष्मं लिङ्गं तद्रहितस्य न स्थूलं शरीरमस्ति न चैतद्विना तेषाम् उपलम्भस्थानमस्तीत्यर्थः॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: शीतोष्णे चैव वायुश्च गुणा राजन् शरीरजाः। तेषां गुणानां साम्यं चेत् तदाहुः स्वस्थलक्षणम्॥३॥
verses.english: The cold, the warin (phlegm and bile) as well as the windy humours, O king, are the essential changes created in the physical body, and when these humours are equally distributed, and are present in due proportions, they indicate good health.

verses.sanskrit: उष्णेन बाध्यते शीतं शीतेनोष्णं च बाध्यते। सत्त्वं रजस्तमश्चेति त्रय आत्मगुणाः स्मृताः॥४॥
verses.english: The warm humour is influenced by the cold. and the cold by the warm. Goodness, Darkness and Ignorance are the attributes of the soul, and it is said by the learned, that their presence in equal parts, indicates health (of the mind). But if any of the three preponderate, some remedy is laid down.
verses.bhavadeepa: शीतोष्णे कफपित्ते वायुर्वातः तेषां साम्ये स्वास्थ्यं वैषम्ये व्याधिर्भवतीत्यर्थः॥३॥

verses.sanskrit: तेषां गुणानां साम्यं चेत् तदाहुः स्वस्थलक्षणम्। तेषामन्यतमोत्सेके विधानमुपदिश्यते॥५॥
verses.bhavadeepa: उष्णेनेति शीतोष्णयोरन्यतराधिक्यजं दोषमितरवर्धकेनौषधादिनाऽपनयेदित्यर्थः। सत्त्वमिति आत्मगुणाः लिङ्गधर्माः॥४॥

verses.sanskrit: हर्षेण बाध्यते शोको हर्षः शोकेन बाध्यते। कश्चिद्दुःखे वर्तमानः सुखस्य स्मर्तुमिच्छति। कश्चित्सुखे वर्तमानो दुःखस्य स्मर्तुमिच्छति॥६॥
verses.english: Happiness is overcome by sorrow, and sorrow by pleasure. Some people while afflicted by sorrow, wish to recall (past) happiness, while others, while in the enjoyment of happiness, wish to recall past sorrow.
verses.bhavadeepa: साम्यं सुप्तिप्रलययोः सत्वरजः कार्ययोः विधानम् उपायः॥५॥

verses.sanskrit: स त्वं न दुःखी दुःखस्य न सुखी सुसुखस्य च। स्मर्तुमिच्छसि कौन्तेय किमन्यद्दुःखविभ्रमात्॥७॥
verses.english: But you, O son of Kunti, do nether wish to recall your sorrows nor your happiness, what else do you wish to recall barring this delusion of sorrow. Or, perchance, O son of Pritha, it is your innate nature, by which you are at present overpowered. You do not wish to recall to your mind the painful spectacle of Krishna standing in the hall of assembly with only one piece of cloth to cover her body, and while she was in her menses and before all the Pandavas. And it is not proper that you should brood over your departure from the city, and your exile with the hide of the antelope for your dress, and your wanderings in the great forest, nor should you recall to your mind the affliction from Jatasura, the fight with Chitrasena, and your troubles from the Saindhavas.
verses.bhavadeepa: हर्षशोकयोः परम्परबाधकत्वमुक्त्वा तमस्तयोर्बाधकं ताभ्यां बाध्यते चेत्याह कश्चिदिति। दुःखकालेऽप्यतीतं सुखं स्मृत्वाप्यतीव व्यामुह्यति न तु तदेव विवेकेन तितिक्षते एवं सुखकालेप्यतीतं पुत्रमरणादिदुःखं स्मृत्वा सिद्धमपि सुखं नाशयतीति भावः॥६॥

verses.sanskrit: अथवा ते स्वभावोऽयं येन पार्थावकृष्यसे। दृष्ट्वा सभागतां कृष्णामेकवस्त्रां रजस्वलाम्। मिषतां पाण्डवेयानां न तस्य स्मर्तुमिच्छसि॥८॥
verses.bhavadeepa: स इति त्वं तु उक्तविधद्विविधव्याधिहीन न सुखं दुखं वा स्मर्तुमिच्छसि नेच्छेरित्यर्थः। किन्तु दुःखविभ्रमात् यद् अन्यद् अकाममशोकं ब्रह्म तदेव स्मर्तुमनुसंधातुमिच्छसि इच्छेरित्यर्थः॥७॥

verses.sanskrit: प्रव्राजनं च नगरादजिनैश्च विवासनम्। महारण्यनिवासश्च न तस्य स्मर्तुमिच्छसि॥९॥
verses.bhavadeepa: अथवेति। अयं दुःखित्वादि तत्स्वभावस्यापि तव शोको न युक्तोतीतत्वाहुः स्वस्येति भावः॥८॥

verses.sanskrit: जटासुरात्परिक्लेशश्चित्रसेनेन चाहवः। सैन्धवाच्च परिक्लेशो न तस्य स्मर्तुमिच्छसि॥१०॥
पुनरज्ञातचर्यायां कीचकेन पदा वधः। याज्ञसेन्यास्तथा पार्थ न तस्य स्मर्तुमिच्छसि॥११॥
verses.english: Nor it is meet, O son of Pritha, and conqueror of your foes, that you should recall the incident of Kichaka's kicking Draupadi, during the period of your exile passed in absolute concealment, nor the incidents of the fight which took place between yourself and Drona and Bhishma. The time has now arrived, when you must fight which each must do single-handed with his mind.

verses.sanskrit: यच्च ते द्रोणभीष्माभ्यां युद्धमासीदरिन्दम। मनसैकेन योद्धव्यं तत्ते युद्धमुपस्थितम्॥१२॥
तस्मादभ्युपगन्तव्यं युद्धाय भरतर्षभ। परमव्यक्तरूपस्य पारं युक्त्या स्वकर्मभिः॥१३॥
verses.english: Therefore, O chief of Bharata's race, you must now prepare to carry the struggle against your mind, and by dint of abstraction and the merit of your own Karma, you must reach the other side of the mysterious and unintelligible (mind).

verses.sanskrit: यत्र नैव शरैः कार्यं न भृत्यैर्न च बन्धुभिः। आत्मनैकेन योद्धव्यं तत् ते युद्धमुपस्थितम्॥१४॥
verses.english: In this war there will be no need for any weapons nor for friends nor attendants. The battle which is to be fought alone and singlehanded has now arrived for you.
verses.bhavadeepa: अभ्युपगन्तव्यम् अभिमुखी भवितव्यम् अव्यक्तरूपस्य मायामात्रस्य मनसः परं पारं ब्रह्म युक्त्या योगेन कर्मभिश्च शोधकैः प्राप्नुहीति शेषः। मनोनाशेन निःशोको भविष्यसीत्यर्थः॥१३॥

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्ननिर्जिते युद्धे कामवस्थां गमिष्यसि। एतज्ज्ञात्वा तु कौन्तेय कृतकृत्यो भविष्यसि॥१५॥
verses.english: And if defeated in this struggle, you shall find yourself in the most wretched condition, and, O son of Kunti, knowing this, and acting accordingly, shall you attain success.

verses.sanskrit: एतां बुद्धिं विनिश्चित्य भूतानामागतिं गतिम्। पितृपैतामहे वृत्ते शाधि राज्यं यथोचितम्॥१६॥
verses.english: And knowing this wisdom and the destiny of all creatures, and following the conduct of your forefathers do you duly govern your kingdom.
